settings.subtitle: Modes · Models · Authentication · Custom providers
settings.prompts.modesDesc: Per-mode system-prompt addendum appended to the base prompt. Leave a mode at its default to write no override.
settings.prompts.autoTitleDesc: System prompt for the model that generates session titles. A non-empty value replaces the built-in default — but the language instruction (from hmm-code.language) is always appended regardless.
settings.prompts.autoTitlePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default. The language line is always added on top of whatever you write here.
settings.prompts.compactDesc: Extra focus appended to the context-summarization prompt. Pi's base summary prompt cannot be replaced — this is added as "Additional focus: …".

settings.general.languageDesc: UI display language. "Auto" follows VS Code's display language; otherwise English.
settings.autoTitle.heading: Auto-title
settings.autoTitle.desc: Model used to auto-generate the session title. Leave empty to use the current session's active model (same model you're chatting with — no separate provider auth needed). Set a dedicated model here if you prefer.
settings.autoTitle.label: Auto title
settings.auth.heading: Provider authentication (auth.json)
settings.auth.desc:
API key: just enter a built-in provider id + key (no custom provider registration needed). e.g. anthropic=Claude, openai=OpenAI, google=Gemini, xai=Grok, groq, deepseek, openrouter …

settings.providers.headingDesc: Register OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, self-hosted, etc.). Models from built-in providers are auto-detected — no need to register them here.
settings.providers.empty: No custom providers registered. Start with "+ Add provider" below.
settings.providers.sub: Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider. Follows Pi's models.json schema.

settings.models.imageTitle: Check if the model accepts image input (vision). When off, images are replaced with a placeholder before being sent.

settings.allowlist.empty: No models available yet. They populate automatically once a chat session starts.

settings.compact.heading: Context auto-summarization
settings.compact.desc: When context usage reaches this percent, the conversation is automatically summarized (compacted) to free up room. Lower = compact earlier/more often; higher = later. Range 50–80 (up to 90 with dynamic compaction off).
settings.compact.dynamicDesc: On (default): never interrupt the agent mid-turn — compact at the turn boundary once usage passes the threshold, with a forced compaction only if usage climbs 10% past it. Off: compact the moment the threshold is crossed, even mid-turn (legacy).
settings.toolOutputs.includeDesc: Off (default): tool outputs older than a recent window are replaced with a short notice in the model's context (the full output always stays in the saved transcript) — keeps context lean so compaction fires less often. On: keep every tool output in context verbatim.
settings.autoApprove.heading: Permissions
settings.autoApprove.label: Auto-approve permissions in new sessions
settings.autoApprove.desc: Off (default): tool actions that would normally prompt for permission ask each time. On: new chat sessions start with permission auto-approve turned ON, so those actions are auto-approved for the session.
settings.todoPanel.label: Pin task list to the top
settings.todoPanel.desc: On (default): when the agent uses the task-list tool, the list is pinned to the top of the chat and updated live; the in-chat update collapses to a one-line summary, and a Done button appears once every task is complete. Off: the full task list renders inline in the chat (legacy).
settings.autoContinue.label: Continue after auto-compaction
settings.autoContinue.desc: On (default): when the context is auto-compacted at a turn boundary and tasks are still incomplete, the agent is automatically prompted to continue the remaining work. Stops once all tasks are done, or after a few rounds with no task completed. Manual compaction never auto-continues.
settings.defaultMode.heading: Default mode
settings.defaultMode.desc: Mode a NEW session starts in. Existing sessions always reopen in the mode they were last in.
settings.retention.heading: Plan & report retention
settings.retention.desc: Plan files (finalize_plan) and implementation reports (finalize_implementation) under ~/.pi/agent are deleted automatically once they are older than this many days (checked at session start). Set 0 to keep them forever.
settings.compactModel.desc: Model used to summarize the context during compaction. Leave empty to use the active session model. Set a dedicated (e.g. cheaper/faster) model to offload summarization off your chat model.
settings.compactModel.label: Summary model
